progress.name_zh: 法律事务管理 (Legal Matter Management)

definition.name: Legal Matter Management
definition.name_zh: 法律事务管理 (Legal Matter Management)
definition.overview:
A **Legal Matter Management** application is a legal function's system of record for its own work. It organizes everything the legal team does — disputes, contract negotiations, reviews, advice requests, investigations, compliance questions — into **matters**: persistent, individually identified records that each carry an accumulated file, a set of responsible people, and a tracked state from opening to closure.

The defining core is small. Remove the matter as the unit of record and the product becomes a task tracker. Remove the accumulated file and it becomes a bare register. Remove managed progression and accountability, and it becomes a shared drive plus a to-do list. What makes the Type is the conjunction: one place where a legal department's entire workload exists as identifiable matters, each with its file, its people, and its status, inspectable as a population at any moment.

Matters are not contracts (agreements are a different object, even when managed in the same suite) and not court cases (the court keeps its own register). The matter is the legal department's own working container for a piece of legal work. In mature products the matter's file also carries the money attributed to it — budgets, invoices from outside counsel, internal time — but spend is a capability layered onto the matter, not what defines it.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**法律事务管理**应用是法律职能部门用于记录自身工作的系统。它将法律团队完成的所有工作——争议、合同谈判、审查、咨询请求、调查、合规问题——组织成**事务**：这些是持久、独立识别的记录，每条记录都包含一个累积的文件、一组负责人员，以及从创建到关闭的跟踪状态。

其定义的核心是精简的。如果移除作为记录单位的事务，产品就变成了一个任务跟踪器。如果移除累积的文件，它就变成了一个简单的登记册。如果移除受管的进展流程和问责制，它就变成了一个共享驱动器加上一个待办事项列表。定义**类型**的关键在于上述要素的结合：在一个地方，法律部门的全部工作量以可识别的事务形式存在，每个事务都有其文件、其人员及其状态，可随时作为整体进行检视。

事务不是合同（协议是另一类对象，即使在同一套件中管理），也不是法院案件（法院保留自己的登记簿）。事务是法律部门自身用于处理一件法律工作的容器。在成熟产品中，事务的文件还承载归属于该事务的资金——预算、外部律师的账单、内部工时——但支出是叠加在事务之上的能力，而非其定义。
definition.dc: The **matter** is the central object: a persistent, individually identified record of one discrete piece of legal work. It carries:
definition.dc_zh: 核心对象是 **事务 (matter)**：一个被持续、独立标识的，代表一项离散法律工作的记录。它承载着：
definition.rules:
- **Membership is not the same as access.** A matter has people actively working on it (members, who see it in their own worklist and get notifications) and separately people or teams granted visibility. Many products also let a matter be **restricted**, hiding it from everyone except explicitly granted parties — confidentiality posture is built into the object, not bolted on.
- **State changes are privileged.** Ordinary users can work a matter but cannot generally move its state; closure in particular is reserved to accountable roles and may be blocked until required completion data is entered.
- **The matter file is expected to be complete.** The department relies on the matter (not email) as its record; the system therefore pulls work into the matter — inbox filing, email-to-matter bridges, invoice uploads attributed to the matter — and prompts at closure about unfinished tasks and outstanding billing.
- **Outside-counsel money flows through matter attribution.** Invoices from firms cite the matter; approval, budget, and reporting machinery hangs off that attribution.
- **Business users see a bounded world.** Internal clients can request, view status, and self-serve, but they do not operate matters; the legal function retains control over triage, assignment, and closure.
- **The identifier is stable.** Matters are numbered by the system and that identity does not change, because invoices, links, and history all cite it.
definition.rules_zh:
- **成员身份与访问权限不同。** 一个事务有积极参与工作的人员（成员，他们在自己的工作列表中看到该事务并接收通知），以及另外被授予可见性的个人或团队。许多产品还允许对事务进行**限制**，除明确授权方外对所有人隐藏——保密姿态内建于对象之中，而非事后附加。
- **状态变更是有权限的。** 普通用户可以处理事务，但通常不能更改其状态；特别是关闭操作，通常保留给负责的角色，并且可能在需要完成的数据输入完成前无法进行。
- **事务文件预期是完整的。** 部门依赖事务（而非电子邮件）作为其记录；因此系统会将工作拉入事务中——收件箱归档、邮件到事务的桥接、归属于该事务的账单上传——并在关闭时提示未完成的任务和未结算的账单。
- **外部律师的费用通过事务归属流转。** 律所的账单引用事务；审批、预算和报告机制都依赖于该归属。
- **业务用户看到的是一个有限的世界。** 内部客户可以发起请求、查看状态和自助服务，但他们不操作事务；法律职能保留对分诊、分配和关闭的控制权。
- **标识符是稳定的。** 事务由系统编号，该标识不会改变，因为账单、链接和历史记录都引用它。

definition.name: Legal Operations Platform
definition.overview:
A **Legal Operations Platform** is an in-house legal department's system of record for running the legal function as an operation. It joins, in one system, the three things a legal department manages as a whole: its **work** (matters), its **external money** (invoices from law firms and legal vendors, budgets, accruals, attributed to that work), and its **vendors** (the outside firms and legal service providers performing it) — and it holds all of it inspectable as a department-level management surface.

The category is also sold as **Enterprise Legal Management (ELM)** or **legal department software**; vendors use the labels interchangeably, and this document treats them as one Type. The name comes from the discipline it serves — *legal operations*, the business-and-administration side of running an in-house legal department ("everything but the practice of law") — but the software is not defined by the existence of a formal legal-ops team. Small teams without one still need the same span.

The defining core is a conjunction. Remove the money-and-vendor layer and what remains is a Legal Matter Management application. Keep only the money layer and it becomes a legal spend/e-billing point tool. Keep the records but lose the department-level oversight loop and it degrades into disconnected point tools plus a BI dashboard. What makes the Type is the join: work, money, and vendors as one connected record set that the whole department is run from.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**法律运营平台**是内部法律部门作为运营运行法律职能的记录系统。它在一个系统中连接了法律部门整体管理的三个要素：其**工作**（事务）、其**外部资金**（来自律师事务所和法律供应商的发票、预算、应计费用，归属于该工作）以及其**供应商**（执行工作的外部律师事务所和法律服务提供商）——并且它将所有内容作为部门级管理界面保持可检查。

该类别也被称为**Enterprise Legal Management (ELM)**或**法律部门软件**；供应商互换使用这些标签，本文将其视为一个类型。名称源于其所服务的学科——*法律运营*，即运营内部法律部门的业务和管理方面（“法律实践以外的一切”）——但该软件并非由正式法律运营团队的存在所定义。没有此类团队的小型团队仍然需要相同的范围。

定义性核心是一个结合体。移除资金和供应商层，剩下的是法律事务管理应用。仅保留资金层，则变为法律支出/电子计费点工具。保留记录但失去部门级监督循环，则退化为不连接的点工具加上BI仪表板。使其成为该类型的是结合：工作、资金和供应商作为一个连接的记录集，整个部门基于此运行。
definition.dc:
```text
Business demand
   ↓ (intake — standard capability)
MATTER — the department's work record
   ├── people: in-house team + outside-firm lawyers
   ├── file: documents, tasks, deadlines, status
   └── spend attributed to it
        ↑ attributed by
VENDOR / LAW FIRM — the party doing external work
   └── engagement + invoices (budgets, accruals alongside)
             ↓
Invoice → reviewed under the department's billing guidelines
        → approved / adjusted / declined → handed to AP for payment
             
DEPARTMENT OVERSIGHT
   dashboards & reports over demand, matters, spend, vendors
```

- **The matter as the work record.** The unit of legal work — a dispute, a contract negotiation, a review, an advice request — is a persistent, identified record with people, a state, and a file. This object is shared with Legal Matter Management; here it is the anchor that spend attaches to, and its file depth is a capability rather than the platform's identity. Matters are classified in the department's own taxonomy (matter types with configurable fields per type in mature products).
- **The vendor record.** Every outside firm or legal service provider exists as a managed record in a directory: who they are, their engagement terms, rates and timekeepers, and their history with the department. Vendors are not just payees — they are participants whose access to matters is granted and scoped by the department.
- **The money records.** External legal spend exists as structured records, not as email attachments: **invoices** submitted by vendors and attributed to matters, **budgets** set per matter, cost center, or department, and **accruals** — estimates of work performed but not yet billed, collected between billing cycles so finance is never surprised. In mature products invoice data arrives in structured formats (industry e-billing formats) or is extracted from other formats.
- **The attribution join.** An invoice cites both a vendor and a matter (or other department-defined allocation). This is the structural join of the whole Type: it is what makes spend-by-matter, spend-by-firm, and budget-vs-actual computable, and it is why work and money live in one system rather than two.
- **The review-and-approval gate.** Invoices do not flow passively to payment. Each is captured into the platform and passes a department-controlled cycle — checked against billing guidelines, reviewed (increasingly with AI assistance), then approved, adjusted, or declined — before being handed to accounts payable. This gate is the founding pillar of the category: controlling outside-counsel spend is the problem the software grew out of.
- **The oversight layer.** The whole population — incoming demand, matters in progress, spend committed, vendor performance — is held as reportable data. Dashboards and reports over volume, cycle time, spend by firm/matter/practice area, and budget variance are the recurring management surface on which legal leadership runs the department.
definition.dc_zh:
业务需求
   ↓ (接收 — 标准能力)
MATTER — 部门的工作记录
   ├── 人员: 内部团队 + 外部律所律师
   ├── 文件: 文档、任务、截止日期、状态
   └── 归属于它的支出
        ↑ 归属于
VENDOR / 律所 — 执行外部工作的一方
   └── 业务关系 + 发票 (预算、应计费用并行)
             ↓
发票 → 根据部门的计费准则进行审查
        → 批准 / 调整 / 拒绝 → 交给应付账款部门付款
             
部门监督
   仪表板和报告，涵盖需求、事务、支出、供应商

- **事务作为工作记录。** 法律工作的单位——一个争议、合同谈判、审查或咨询请求——是一个持久的、有标识的记录，包含人员、状态和文件。此对象与法律事务管理共享；在这里，它是支出所依附的锚点，其文件深度是一种能力而非平台的身份。事务按部门自身的分类法进行分类（在成熟产品中，事务类型具有每个类型的可配置字段）。

- **供应商记录。** 每个外部律所或法律服务提供商都作为目录中的受管记录存在：他们是谁、业务关系条款、费率和计时员，以及他们与部门的历史。供应商不仅仅是收款方——他们是参与者，其访问事务的权限被授予一个...
definition.rules:
- **Attribution is the join.** An invoice is captured against a matter and a vendor. The department's spend reporting, budgets, and vendor evaluation all hang off this attribution; unattributed spend breaks the model the platform exists to provide.
- **The invoice lifecycle is governed, and payment comes after approval.** Invoices move through submitted → reviewed → approved/adjusted/declined, with the actions recorded. Approved invoices are handed to accounts payable; the payment itself is executed in the finance system, with the outcome typically recorded back on the invoice in the platform. Adjustments and rejections are recorded, not silently overwritten — the audit trail is part of the value to finance and to vendor negotiations.
- **Billing guidelines are rules, not documents.** The department's outside-counsel guidelines are encoded as enforceable checks applied at review (rates, timekeepers, billing practices). What is checked, and what happens on violation (flag, block, adjust), is configuration.
- **Vendors are scoped participants.** A firm sees only the matters (and the billing duties) its engagement grants; some products also support billing-only engagements, where a firm invoices against a matter without working in it. The department controls access levels per vendor.
- **Accruals run between billing cycles.** Firms are asked to estimate unbilled work on a recurring cadence so the department (and finance) can see committed-but-uninvoiced exposure; budgets and accruals are reconciled against invoices as they arrive.
- **Business users see a bounded world.** They request, track, and sometimes self-serve; they do not operate matters, approve spend, or see the whole population.
- **One record set, deliberately.** The platform's posture is to replace spreadsheets, shared drives, and email-based invoice handling: search and reporting are expected to reach matters, documents, notes, invoices, and vendor data alike, and integration pipes carry approved data outward to finance and BI rather than duplicating it.
definition.rules_zh:
- **归属是连接点。** 一张发票针对一个事务和一个供应商捕获。部门的支出报告、预算和供应商评估都基于此归属；未归属的支出会打破平台旨在提供的模型。
- **发票生命周期受监管，支付发生在批准后。** 发票经历提交→审查→批准/调整/拒绝，动作被记录。批准的发票交给应付账款；支付本身在财务系统中执行，结果通常记录回平台的发票上。调整和拒绝被记录，而不是静默覆盖——审计跟踪是对财务和供应商谈判的价值的一部分。
- **计费指南是规则，不是文档。** 部门的外部律师指南被编码为在审查时应用的强制性检查（费率、计时员、计费实践）。检查什么以及违规时发生什么（标记、阻止、调整）是配置。
- **供应商是范围参与者。** 律所只能看到其合作授予的事务（和计费职责）；一些产品也支持仅计费合作，其中律所针对事务开发票而不参与其中。部门控制每个供应商的访问级别。
- **应计费用在计费周期之间运行。** 循环性地要求律所估计未开票工作，以便部门（和财务）看到承诺但未开票的暴露；预算和应计费用在发票到达时与之对账。
- **业务用户看到有限的世界。** 他们请求、跟踪，有时自助服务；他们不操作事务、批准支出或查看整个群体。
- **一个记录集，刻意为之。** 平台的立场是替换电子表格

progress.name_zh: 法律费用管理 (Legal Spend Management)

definition.name: Legal Spend Management
definition.name_zh: 法律费用管理 (Legal Spend Management)
definition.overview:
A **Legal Spend Management** application is the buying side of the legal-services relationship: a system of record for the *money* an organization pays to external legal providers — law firms and other legal service vendors — held under the buyer's control from bill arrival to payment handoff.

Its defining core is three things held together:

```text
External legal bills captured as structured records,
attributed to the work they pay for and the provider that billed them
    └── a buyer-controlled review gate
        (bills checked against the department's billing rules;
         adjusted, declined, or approved before payment)
        └── the whole function's money position
            (total legal spend across all providers and matters,
             held as one inspectable, reportable picture)
```

The problem the Type solves is structural: outside legal work is billed by independent providers under negotiated rates and billing rules, in formats the providers choose, against matters the buyer owns. Without this system, bills arrive as email attachments, review is ad hoc, negotiated terms are enforced by memory, and the true cost of legal surfaces only at month end. A legal spend management application turns that flow into governed data: every bill becomes a record, every record passes a gate, and every approved dollar lands in a picture of the department's total legal spend.

The boundary matters because the market bundles this money layer with neighboring capabilities. It is not the system where legal *work* is managed (that is matter management); not the system where the law-firm *relationship* is managed — selecting firms, setting engagement terms, evaluating performance (that is outside counsel management); not the whole joined department platform (legal operations platform); and not the firm-side system that generates the bills in the first place (legal billing). It is the layer those bundles all share and depend on: the money itself. "Legal spend management" is also used in market naming as an umbrella for entire legal-operations suites; this document describes the money layer the name literally denotes.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**法律支出管理**应用是法律服务关系中的采购方：作为记录*资金*的系统，记录一个组织支付给外部法律提供者——律所和其他法律服务供应商——的款项，由采购方控制从账单接收到付款移交的全过程。

其定义核心是三件事的结合：

```text
外部法律账单作为结构化记录被捕获，
归属到它们所支付的工作以及开具账单的提供者
    └── 采购方控制的审核关卡
        （账单根据部门的计费规则进行检查；
         在付款前进行调整、拒绝或批准）
        └── 整个职能的资金头寸
            （所有提供者和事项的总法律支出，
             作为一个可检查、可报告的全景呈现）
```

该类型解决的问题是结构性的：外部法律工作由独立的提供者按照协商的费率和计费规则开具账单，使用提供者选择的格式，针对采购方拥有的事项。没有这个系统，账单以电子邮件附件形式到达，审核是临时的，协商的条款靠记忆来执行，法律的真实成本只能在月底显现。法律支出管理应用将该流程转变为受控的数据：每张账单成为一个记录，每个记录通过一个关卡，每个批准的美元都归入部门总法律支出的一个全景图中。

这个边界很重要，因为市场将这个资金层与相邻能力捆绑在一起。它不是管理法律*工作*的系统（那是案件管理）；不是管理律所*关系*的系统——选择律所、设定合作条款、评估绩效（那是外部律师管理）；不是整个连接的部门平台（法律运营平台）；也不是最初生成账单的律所端系统（法律计费）。它是所有这些捆绑都共享和依赖的层：资金本身。"法律支出管理"在市场命名中也用作整个法律运营套件的总称；本文档描述的是该名称字面所指的资金层。
definition.dc: External legal spend exists in the system as structured records, not attachments:
definition.dc_zh: 外部法律费用以结构化记录而非附件形式存在于系统中
definition.rules:
- **No payment before the gate.** A bill cannot become payable until it has passed review; approved bills are handed to accounts payable, and the payment itself executes in the finance system with the outcome recorded back. This ordering — review before payment — is the structural difference from generic invoice processing, where approval is the process; here approval is enforcement of pre-agreed legal terms.
- **Guidelines are rules, not documents.** The department's outside-counsel guidelines are encoded as checks applied to every bill. What is checked, and whether a violation flags, blocks, or auto-adjusts, is configuration — and the guidelines themselves are expected to change as rates and needs change.
- **Attribution is the join.** Every bill cites a matter and a provider. Spend reporting, budgets, accrual reconciliation, and analytics all hang off this attribution; a bill that cannot be attributed breaks the model.
- **Adjustments are recorded, never erased.** The audit trail from submission through approval (and payment) is retained — it serves finance, vendor negotiations, and compliance review.
- **Providers see a scoped world.** A firm sees its own bills, adjustments, and engaged matters — not the department's other spend. Some products support billing-only engagements, where a provider invoices against a matter without working in it.
- **Accruals live between cycles.** Estimates are collected on a recurring cadence, reconciled against bills as they arrive, and are understood to be estimates — the bill remains the authoritative record.
- **All external legal spend counts.** The money position spans law firms and other legal service providers alike; the department's total legal cost is the unit of oversight, not one firm's bill.
definition.rules_zh:
- **关卡之前不付款。** 账单在通过审核之前不能成为应付款；批准的账单移交给应付账款，付款本身在财务系统中执行，结果被记录回去。这种顺序——审核在付款前——是与通用发票处理的结构性差异，在后者中，审批就是流程；在这里，审批是对预先商定法律条款的执行。
- **指南是规则，不是文件。** 部门的外部律师指南被编码为应用于每张账单的检查项。检查什么，以及违规是触发标记、阻止还是自动调整，是配置——而指南本身预计会随着费率和需求的变化而变化。
- **归属是连接点。** 每张账单都引用一个案件和一个提供者。支出报告、预算、应计核对和分析都依赖于此归属；无法归属的账单会破坏该模型。
- **调整被记录，从不擦除。** 从提交到批准（以及付款）的审计跟踪被保留——它服务于财务、供应商谈判和合规审查。
- **提供者看到一个有范围的世界。** 律所看到自己的账单、调整和参与的事项——而不是部门的其他支出。一些产品支持纯计费合作，即提供者针对一个事项开具发票而无需在其中工作。
- **应计存在于周期之间。** 估算按固定节奏收集，在账单到达时进行核对，并被理解为是估算——账单仍然是权威记录。
- **所有外部法律支出都计算在内。** 资金头寸涵盖律所和其他法律服务提供者；部门的总法律成本是监督的单位，而不是一家律所的账单。

definition.name: Litigation Management Platform
definition.overview:
A **Litigation Management Platform** is a party-side system of record for litigated disputes: it holds each litigated case as a persistent record — the dispute's adverse parties, their representation, the court or forum, and the case's current posture — and works that case through the operating machinery of a proceeding: litigation stages, calendared litigation events with limitation-period risk, and the case's discovery and evidence layer.

The defining core is deliberately small:

```text
Litigated Case of Record
└── Parties & representation (claimant, defendant, counsel, co-counsel, experts)
    └── Forum/court context and current procedural posture
        └── The proceeding worked as litigation
            ├── Litigation stages / phase plans
            ├── Litigation events + deadline & limitation-period calendaring
            └── Discovery & evidence layer (requests, productions, experts, key documents)
```

Everything else commonly associated with these products — settlement and demand tracking, litigation budgets and billing-guideline compliance, medical-damages material, client portals, portfolio dashboards, AI summaries — is widespread but not what makes the software a litigation management system. The same is true on the buyer side: budgets, panel-counsel management and spend control are the oversight layer that dispute-owning organizations (corporations, insurers, governments) add on top.

The Type is realized in two market poles: **litigation firms** running plaintiff or defense caseloads (the standalone product family), and **dispute owners** — in-house legal, insurers, government agencies — whose litigated-case oversight is usually packaged inside matter management, enterprise legal management suites, or claims systems.
definition.overview_zh:
一款**诉讼管理平台**是处理诉讼争议的当事方记录系统：它将每一起诉讼案件作为持久记录保存——记录争议的各方当事人、其代理律师、受理法院或仲裁庭，以及案件的当前诉讼态势——并通过诉讼程序的运作机制处理该案件：诉讼阶段、具有诉讼时效风险的法定日历事件，以及案件的证据开示与证据层。

其定义性核心被刻意设计得十分精简：

```text
记录在案的诉讼案件
└── 当事人与代理（索赔方、被告、律师、共同律师、专家）
    └── 法院/仲裁庭背景与当前程序态势
        └── 作为诉讼进行的程序
            ├── 诉讼阶段 / 阶段计划
            ├── 诉讼事件 + 截止日期与诉讼时效日历
            └── 证据开示与证据层（请求、出示文件、专家、关键文件）
```

这些产品通常关联的其他所有功能——和解与索赔追踪、诉讼预算与账单合规、医疗损害材料、客户门户、案件组合仪表板、AI摘要——虽然普遍，但并非该软件成为诉讼管理系统的决定性特征。买方视角同样如此：预算、律师团管理与支出控制是拥有争议的组织（企业、保险公司、政府机构）在其之上添加的监督层。

该类型在市场上通过两个极点实现：运营原告或被告案件量的**诉讼律所**（独立产品家族），以及**争议所有者**——公司内部法律部门、保险公司、政府机构——其对诉讼案件的监督通常被整合在事务管理、企业法律管理套件或理赔系统之中。
definition.dc: The central object is the **case**: a persistent, individually identified record of one dispute prosecuted or defended in a forum (court, arbitration, tribunal, administrative body). A case carries:
definition.dc_zh: 核心对象是 **案件**：在法庭、仲裁庭、裁判庭或行政机构等场所中，对一起诉讼、辩护或争议进行追诉或辩护而产生的、具有持久性且独立标识的记录。每个案件包含：
definition.rules:
- **Deadlines are guarded as malpractice-level risk.** Limitation periods and court-rule deadlines attach to the case record with owners, reminders, and attribution; computation from jurisdictional rules is the mature implementation, manual entry the baseline.
- **Posture follows the forum.** The case's stage changes as the court or tribunal acts, not merely as internal work completes; the case record mirrors a proceeding conducted outside the system.
- **Adverse-party identity is structural.** Conflict screening against existing parties happens before acceptance; parties and representation are recorded on the case, not just in a contact list.
- **Economics couple to the case, not the timesheet alone.** Plaintiff-side value lives in the settlement/demand record; defense- and buyer-side control lives in budgets and guidelines applied per case; timekeeping and billing exist around these, not instead of them.
- **The case file is a durable record.** Documents, communications, events and history persist on the case across staff changes and handoffs — litigation is long-lived work that passes through many hands.
- **Roles and access matter most on the buyer side.** Assignment of cases to firms or staff counsel, visibility to outside collaborators, and audit trails for reporting to insurers or management are common governed behaviors.
definition.rules_zh:
- **截止日期被视为重大执业风险。** 诉讼时效和法院规则规定的截止日期与案件记录绑定，包含负责人、提醒和归属；根据管辖规则进行自动计算是成熟的实现方式，手动输入是基础要求。
- **诉讼态势随法院而变。** 案件的阶段随着法院或仲裁庭的行动而改变，而不仅仅是内部工作完成；案件记录反映的是在系统之外进行的程序。
- **对方当事人身份具有结构性。** 接受委托前需对现有当事人进行利益冲突筛查；当事人和代理关系记录在案件上，而不仅仅是在联系人列表中。
- **经济性与案件相关，而不仅与计时表挂钩。** 原告端的价值体现在和解/索赔记录中；被告及买方端的控制体现在应用于每个案件的预算和指南中；计时和账单围绕这些内容展开，而非取而代之。
- **案件卷宗是持久记录。** 文件、沟通、事件和历史记录在案件上得以保留，跨越人员变动和交接——诉讼是历时很长、经手多人的工作。
- **角色和权限在买方端最为重要。** 将案件分配给律所或内部律师、对外部合作者的可见性、以及向保险公司或管理层汇报的审计跟踪，都是常见的受控行为。

definition.name: Outside Counsel Management
definition.overview:
An **Outside Counsel Management** application is the buyer-side system a corporate legal department uses to manage its external law firms as governed vendors: it keeps a registry of firms and their commercial terms, attaches firms to matters under those terms, forces every firm-submitted invoice through a review where the department can adjust, reject, or approve it before payment, and records the resulting spend against both the firm and the matter.

It solves the problem that in-house legal teams buy legal services from many firms, on negotiated rates, under written billing rules — and without a system, that relationship lives in spreadsheets, email, and paper invoices, with no reliable way to enforce terms, see spend, or compare firms.

The defining core is small:

```text
Registry of outside law firms (with commercial terms)
└── Engagement of a firm to a matter under those terms
    └── Firm-submitted invoice → buyer-controlled review
        │   (adjust / reject / approve before payment)
        └── Spend attributed to firm and matter
```

Everything else commonly associated with the category — panel governance, rate benchmarking, budgets and accruals, firm portals, scorecards, AI invoice review — is standard capability that mature products add, not what makes the product this Type. The pre-software process (panel lists, engagement letters, paper bills checked against fee schedules) has the same structure, which is why none of those modern specifics belong in the definition.

In the market this Type is rarely sold alone: it ships bundled with matter management, and the bundle is usually called Enterprise Legal Management (ELM) or "legal spend management." The outside-counsel view — the firm relationship and its cost — is the part documented here.
definition.overview_zh:
一个**外部律师管理**应用程序是企业法务部门用来管理其外部律师事务所作为受控供应商的买方系统：它维护一个律师事务所及其商业条款的登记表，将律师事务所与案件在这些条款下关联起来，强制每个律师事务所提交的发票经过审查，部门可以在支付前调整、拒绝或批准它，并记录由此产生的支出与律师事务所和案件的对应关系。

它解决了内部法律团队从多家律师事务所以协商费率购买法律服务的问题，在书面计费规则下——如果没有系统，这种关系存在于电子表格、电子邮件和纸质发票中，没有可靠的方式来执行条款、查看支出或比较律师事务所。

定义性核心很小：

```text
外部律师事务所登记表（包含商业条款）
└── 将律师事务所在这些条款下委托给一个案件
    └── 律师事务所提交发票 → 买方控制审查
        │   （在支付前调整/拒绝/批准）
        └── 支出归因于律师事务所和案件
```

与该类别相关的其他一切——面板管理、费率基准测试、预算和应计、律师事务所门户、评分卡、AI发票审查——是成熟产品添加的标准功能，而不是使该产品成为这种类型的因素。预软件流程（面板列表、聘约函、纸质账单核对费用表）具有相同的结构，这就是为什么这些现代细节都不属于定义。

在市场上，这种类型很少单独销售：它通常与案件管理捆绑销售，该捆绑通常称为企业法律管理（ELM）或“法律支出管理”。外部律师视角——律师事务所关系及其成本——是本文档所记录的部分。
definition.dc:
**Law firm (vendor record).** Each external firm is a managed record in the buyer's registry: identity, contacts, panel status, and — critically — its commercial terms: agreed rates, fee arrangements, discounts, and the billing guidelines it must follow. Engagement letters and related documents are kept against the record. The registry is the system of record for who the department's firms are and on what terms.

**Matter.** The unit of legal work (a case, a deal, a regulatory project). Matters are created in the system — often with intake and routing — and are the anchor to which firms are engaged and invoices are billed. The matter does not need the full document/deadline machinery of matter management, but every engagement and every invoice must attribute to one.

**Engagement and terms.** An engagement attaches a firm (and its timekeepers) to a matter under recorded terms: which rate schedule applies, what fee arrangement (hourly, capped, fixed, or other alternative structures), and which billing guidelines govern. Terms are the review basis: an invoice is judged against the terms of the engagement that produced it.

**Timekeeper.** The individual billers at the firm (partners, associates, paralegals), each with a role and an approved rate. Buyers commonly require that new timekeepers and rate increases be approved before they can bill — so the timekeeper list is a controlled population, not free text on an invoice.

**Invoice.** The firm-submitted bill: a header (firm, matter, period, totals) plus line items (timekeeper, date, task classification, narrative, hours, rate, amount; expenses similarly). The invoice has a lifecycle owned by the buyer: submitted → validated and reviewed → adjusted, rejected, or approved → paid. Rejected invoices go back to the firm for correction and resubmission.

**Spend ledger.** Approved invoice amounts accumulate as spend attributed to the firm and the matter. This ledger is what budgets, accruals, forecasts, and firm comparisons read from.
definition.dc_zh:
**律师事务所（供应商记录）。** 每家外部律所都是买方注册表中的受管记录：身份、联系人、面板状态，以及关键的商业条款：约定费率、费用安排、折扣和必须遵循的账单指南。聘用函和相关文档根据记录保存。注册表是记录部门律所及其条款的系统。

**事项。** 法律工作的单位（一个案件、交易、监管项目）。事项在系统中创建——通常通过接收和路由——并作为律所聘用和发票计费的锚点。事项不需要事项管理的完整文档/截止日期机制，但每个聘用和每个发票都必须归属于一个事项。

**聘用和条款。** 聘用将律所（及其计时员）与事项在记录条款下关联：适用哪个费率表、什么费用安排（按小时、封顶、固定或其他替代结构），以及哪个账单指南管理。条款是审查基础：发票根据产生它的聘用条款进行评判。

**计时员。** 律所中的个体计费者（合伙人、律师助理、律师助理），每个都有角色和批准费率。买方通常要求新的计时员和费率增加在计费前得到批准——因此计时员列表是一个控制...
definition.rules:
- **No payment before review.** The invoice review gate is the structural point of the Type: a firm bill does not become payable until a buyer-side actor (or a configured automatic rule, where financial controls permit) has adjusted, rejected, or approved it.
- **Terms bind the invoice.** Review is judgment against the engagement's recorded terms — approved rates, approved timekeepers, fee arrangement, billing guidelines. An invoice charging an unapproved rate or unapproved timekeeper is a violation the system can flag automatically.
- **Rejection returns to the firm.** Rejected invoices go back for correction and resubmission; adjustments are visible to the firm, which sees exactly what was cut and why. The buyer's edits are not silent.
- **Engagement is governed.** Which firms may take which work is itself controlled: panel conditions, off-panel approval, competitive-bidding thresholds.
- **Budgets are advisory but visible.** Budget-vs-billed variance is surfaced during review; whether it blocks approval depends on configuration, not on the Type.
- **Everything is audited.** Submission, adjustment, approval, and payment actions are recorded — the trail is a first-class deliverable, both for internal controls and for external financial-compliance regimes.
- **Accruals feed the close.** The system's unbilled-work data is consumed by finance on a periodic cadence; legal and finance share the same numbers.
definition.rules_zh:
- **审查前不支付。** 发票审查关卡是这种类型的结构要点：律师事务所账单在买方行为者（或在财务控制允许的情况下配置的自动规则）调整、拒绝或批准之前，不会成为应付账款。
- **条款约束发票。** 审查是针对聘约记录条款的判断——批准的费率、批准的时间记录员、费用安排、计费指南。收取未批准费率或未批准时间记录员的发票是系统可以自动标记的违规。
- **拒绝返回律师事务所。** 被拒绝的发票返回更正并重新提交；调整对律师事务所可见，他们确切地看到被削减的内容和原因。买方的编辑不是静默的。
- **委托受管理。** 哪些律师事务所可以接受哪些工作本身受控制：面板条件、面板外批准、竞争性招标阈值。
- **预算具有建议性但可见。** 预算与账单对比在审查期间显示；是否阻止批准取决于配置，而不是类型。
- **一切都被审计。** 提交、调整、批准和支付动作都被记录——跟踪是首要交付成果，既用于内部控制，也用于外部财务合规制度。
- **应计用于结账。** 系统的未账单工作数据由财务按定期节奏使用；法律和财务共享相同的数字。
